info.title: GP247 REST API (v1 + v2)
info.description: REST API of gp247/core, gp247/front and gp247/shop. Every error body is {"error":1,"msg":"…","code":"…"}. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (since 3.4.0; a valid id sent by the client is reused). A group turned off on the API management screen answers 404 with code api_disabled (since 3.3.1). See api-introduction.md. API v2 sessions (since core 3.6.0 / shop 3.4.0): with_refresh on login returns a rotating refresh token; a sign-in challenge registered by a plugin answers 401 challenge_required.
